headline: Iraq PM Chairs Meeting on Strategic Export Pipeline Projects | Iraq Business News
summary: A meeting chaired by Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi reviewed technical and economic details of the Basra-Haditha pipeline and the Haditha-Baniyas pipeline. The projects are designed to export crude oil.
why: Iraq is a major OPEC crude producer, and new export pipelines determine how much oil it can ship without relying on the Gulf route. Pipeline capacity affects regional supply.
